name: Secret of the Aliens
description: This paint reflects the suspicious alien object recovered from a crash several years ago at one of the tank polygons. The Object is coated in an unknown material — a molecular structure that couldn't be identified or recreated.
interestingFacts: The paint was available for purchase in a special offer during the 2017 Tanker's Day celebrations - from September 9 to September 11, 2017, for 24.99 USD.
